test_title: PYST 08: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programmes received the highest score in the Data Governance Quality Index (DGQI) for the Department of Rural Development for the year 2023-24?

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana

solution:
The Correct answer is __**National Social Assistance Programme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)** is a **welfare programme** administered by the **Ministry of Rural Development** in India.
 
• It provides **social security** to the economically weaker sections of society, including **senior citizens, widows, and disabled individuals**.
 
• Under this programme, **financial assistance** is given through schemes such as the **Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)**, **Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)**, and **Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)**.
 
• The programme plays a critical role in ensuring **social inclusion** and reducing **poverty and vulnerability** in rural India.
 
• The **Data Governance Quality Index (DGQI)** assesses the quality of data governance practices in government schemes. The **NSAP** received the **highest score** for the **Department of Rural Development** for the year **2023-24**, highlighting its exemplary data management and governance.
 
• Strong data governance in NSAP ensures **accuracy, transparency, and accountability** in its implementation, directly benefiting the targeted population.
 
• This achievement underscores the programme's commitment to leveraging **data-driven insights** for enhanced service delivery and policy-making.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **MGNREGA-Programme Component**__

 __
 
• The **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** is a flagship programme that guarantees **100 days of wage employment** to rural households.
 
• It aims to enhance **livelihood security** by providing wage employment and promoting **sustainable rural development**.
 
• The programme also focuses on the creation of **durable assets** like roads, irrigation canals, and other infrastructure projects.
 
• While MGNREGA excels in rural employment generation, it did not receive the highest DGQI score for 2023-24 under the Department of Rural Development.
 
 
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)**__
 __
 
• The **DDU-GKY** is a skill development initiative aimed at improving **employability** among rural youth.
 
• It focuses on providing **market-linked skills** to rural poor youth aged between 15 and 35 years.
 
• This scheme is part of the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)** and works towards **poverty alleviation** through skill enhancement.
 
• Though impactful, it was not rated the highest in the DGQI for 2023-24.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)**__
 
 
• **PMGSY** is a programme aimed at providing **all-weather road connectivity** to unconnected villages in rural areas.
 
• It focuses on enhancing rural infrastructure, which is crucial for **economic development** and **poverty reduction**.
 
• The scheme's effective implementation has contributed to improved **access to education, healthcare, and markets** for rural populations.
 
• Despite its pivotal role in rural infrastructure, it did not achieve the highest DGQI score for the Department of Rural Development in 2023-24.
